mods.title: Stalker Weapon Pack v3.7
mods.description: We've made a huge number of fixes, from animation settings to a complete redesign of configs. Let's make a reservation right away that we did not touch the performance characteristics, balance, etc., but fixed only the most critical errors. The pack is far from perfect, but we tried to make it playable. The game is fully passable and compatible with all weather mods. The game is fully passable and compatible with all weather mods (with the exception of Atmosfear 3).
